headline: Lodging Lowdown: Viceroy Hotels to debut NYC flagship, Radisson launches app on ChatGPT
summary: Plus, Remington Hospitality added a soon-to-be Hyatt Regency in San Diego to its portfolio, and Langham Hospitality Group named a new chief operating officer.

headline: How To Earn $500 A Month From Marriott Stock Ahead Of Q2 Earnings
summary: Marriott International (MAR) to release Q2 earnings on Aug. 3, with analysts expecting $3.08/share and $7.19B revenue. Stock price target raised by Barclays and TD Cowen. Dividend yield at 0.78%, with $500/month requiring $771,611 investment.
